facts.fact: The document states that the national ICT development policy PNDTIC (2010-2025) was adopted by the Council of Ministers on 13 July 2011.
The policy's title and vision set its period as 2010-2025, with a vision to 2025 of universal ICT access and regional centre of excellence status.

The policy text is hosted as a PDF on the Primature's official site (primature.gov.bi, uploaded 2026/06 per the URL); the document itself gives no publication date, so the document's published date of 2011-07-13 applies to its adoption only.
